violations.description: COLD AND HOT STORAGE EQUIPMENT (4 pts): Coolers in the facility being used for cold holding temp of 41 degrees F was not functioning adequately. 2 door upright salad bar cooler is observed holding food items at 45?F. Staff relocated food items that were out of temperature to the walk in cooler until upright cooler is holding at 41?F or below.

CONTAMINATION BY EMPLOYEES (3 pts): Bare hand contact with ready to eat food noted not being avoided. Observed staff handling buns and adjusting pie on a plate without using single-use gloves or utensils.
STORAGE/HANDLING CLEAN EQUIP & UTENSILS (1 pts): Clean storage container lids with debris build up in storage bins near the baking area.
IN-USE UTENSILS (1 pts): In - use utensil noted being stored with the handle laying in the wait station prep top cooler vegetables.
EMPLOYEE HYGIENE (5 pts): Employee noted handling food while hands were contaminated and did not wash hands before starting work.

STORAGE/HANDLING CLEAN EQUIP & UTENSILS (1 pts): Clean storage container lids with debris build up in storage bin and frozen ice paddle in walk in freezer has debris build up on the paddle itself and on the tray storing the clean paddle.
CROSS CONTAMINATION (5 pts): Observed raw eggs being stored above chopped vegetables in the walk in cooler.
CONTAMINATION FROM WIPING CLOTHS (2 pts): Wiping cloths noted laying on counter in kitchen.

CONTAMINATION DURING STORAGE (2 pts): Food noted being stored not covered in walk-in freezer. Observed a container of soup being cooled in the walk in freezer with ice build up and debris directly above.
NON FOOD CONTACT SURFACES - CLEAN (1 pts): Wire shelving in the walk in freezer noted not clean and built up with frost and ice.
